goals.description: Define a Stage type in internal/pipeline mirroring the 7-value pipeline_stage Postgres enum 1:1
Declare the canonical stage order exactly once, as the single source other code must read instead of re-declaring a sequence
Implement a pure Allowed(from, to Stage) bool that accepts only one-step-forward transitions along the canonical order
Table-driven test covering every valid forward transition plus rejected backward/skip/self/unknown-stage cases
